1.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_000020_ALPHINAUD
1.description: I pray we have not caught you at an inopportune moment. We wanted to offer our thanks for your kind words in the Forum.

2.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_000030_MONTICHAIGNE
2.description: Well, I could hardly let that inquisition go unchallenged.

3.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_000040_MONTICHAIGNE
3.description: I've always believed that curiosity should be nurtured, not stifled. Thankfully, a majority of my colleagues agreed. A slender majority, aye, but a majority nonetheless.

4.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_000050_KRILE
4.description: Had the vote not gone our way, we would be having a very different conversation, if any at all. Though I'd like to think you would have not given up on our cause─I'm told you paid a visit to the annex afterwards?

5.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_000060_MONTICHAIGNE
5.description: Yes, that's right. I was hoping to speak with the grandchildren of my dearly departed friends Galuf and Louisoix in a less dour setting, but it seems I'd just missed you.

6.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_000070_MONTICHAIGNE
6.description: I still can't believe how much you've grown. If only your grandsires could've seen the way you presented yourselves to the Forum. Why, it fair brought a tear to my own eye!

7.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_000080_MONTICHAIGNE
7.description: You must have the patience of a saint, putting up with this lot and their antics─never mind Matoya's prize student.

8.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_000090_MONTICHAIGNE
8.description: Luckily, I know a thing or two about managing unruly younglings. If you ever need advice, don't hesitate to ask!

9.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_000100_ALPHINAUD
9.description: If I may, there is a rather more pressing matter we wish to discuss. What can you tell us of this “duty” that the Forum must fulfill?

10.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_000110_MONTICHAIGNE
10.description: Nothing, I'm afraid. Like all humble servants of the Forum, I am sworn to secrecy.

11.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_000120_MONTICHAIGNE
11.description: Or rather, I couldn't tell you if I tried.

12.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_000130_MONTICHAIGNE
12.description: Our duty is of the gravest importance. Furthermore, if the particulars were made public, it would incite widespread panic.

13.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_000140_MONTICHAIGNE
13.description: As such, those entrusted with this duty have been bound by an enchantment, which prevents us from speaking of such matters without the express permission of the Forum.

15.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_000160_MONTICHAIGNE
15.description: Hahaha... It's been some time since I last gave a lecture. Please, take a seat.

16.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_000170_MONTICHAIGNE
16.description: Ahem! We shall begin by reviewing the fundamentals of aetherology.

17.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_000180_MONTICHAIGNE
17.description: The aether which imbues us with life can be categorized into three forms.

18.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_000190_MONTICHAIGNE
18.description: Two are of the incorporeal sort, the soul and the memory. Can anyone tell me the third?

24.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_000210_MONTICHAIGNE
24.description: Not entirely inaccurate, but nor is it the answer I was looking for. That would be “corporeal aether.”

26.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_000230_MONTICHAIGNE
26.description: This is the form with which the layman is most familiar.

27.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_000240_MONTICHAIGNE
27.description: Consumed by even the simplest of daily activities and replenished by the food and drink that sustain us, this form of aether is in constant flux.

28.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_000250_MONTICHAIGNE
28.description: In contrast, the aether that comprises the soul is rarely subject to dramatic change. The same can be said for memory, as the two are intrinsically linked.

29.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_000260_MONTICHAIGNE
29.description: Picture the soul as paper, and memories as words written upon it.

30.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_000270_MONTICHAIGNE
30.description: Now, what would happen if that paper was doused with ink─the same type of aether as comprises the memories?

31.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_000280_ALISAIE
31.description: It would blot out everything that was written.

32.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_000290_MONTICHAIGNE
32.description: Precisely. We would be unable to recall the memories, and any activities that depend upon them would be hindered as well.

33.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_000300_MONTICHAIGNE
33.description: In fact, this exact phenomenon was observed on a vast scale not so long ago. And what might that have been?

35.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_000320_ALPHINAUD
35.description: The people of Eorzea vividly recall Bahamut breaking free of the lesser moon and raining hellfire down upon the realm.

36.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_000330_ALPHINAUD
36.description: But no one could seem to remember the events that followed immediately afterwards.

37.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_000340_MONTICHAIGNE
37.description: Indeed. To this day, we have yet to determine whether it was an unintended consequence or a deliberate act.

38.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_000350_MONTICHAIGNE
38.description: The enchantment which binds me and the rest of the Forum is based on a similar principle. And yes, it is a contravention of the Sharlayan prohibition against the practice of memory manipulation.

39.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_000360_MONTICHAIGNE
39.description: Only when a new member is inducted and told of our great duty are they subjected to the process.

40.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_000370_MONTICHAIGNE
40.description: A necessary evil. You have my word that it would never be used to manipulate the populace.

41.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_000380_KRILE
41.description: I should hope not. But can this enchantment be dispelled and your memories restored?

42.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_000390_MONTICHAIGNE
42.description: If nine-tenths of our members give their approval, then the process may be reversed. Then, and only then, would we be able to speak freely to others of our sacred duty.

43.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_000400_MONTICHAIGNE
43.description: Barring that, we must wait until we return to the aetherial sea...

44.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_000410_MONTICHAIGNE
44.description: For there we will be purified. The blots upon our souls washed clean...

45.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_000420_MONTICHAIGNE
45.description: And our memories drift apart and dissolve. Rather defeating the purpose, I suppose.

46.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_000430_MONTICHAIGNE
46.description: But there are those memories that are indelibly etched upon our souls, some believe.

48.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_000450_MONTICHAIGNE
48.description: We are reduced to pure aether, coalesce with that of others, and create souls anew.

49.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_000460_MONTICHAIGNE
49.description: Alternative schools of thought assert souls remain whole and return to the corporeal world, reborn into another form.

50.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_000470_MONTICHAIGNE
50.description: Both theories have their proponents. Personally, I consider each equally probable.

51.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_000480_MONTICHAIGNE
51.description: Well, I think that's enough education for today, now that I've given you some food for thought─or rather, an entire banquet!

52.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_000490_MONTICHAIGNE
52.description: I would remind you that although I'm unable to assist you with certain matters, the resources at my disposal may still be of use to you.

53.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_000500_MONTICHAIGNE
53.description: I'll arrange for you all to be given the run of Phenomenon. Of course, as associate to our alumni and the Students of Baldesion, this privilege is extended to you as well, my friend.

54.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_000510_MONTICHAIGNE
54.description: Oh, and I suggest you speak with Qih Aliapoh. She's well known among the artisans of Sharlayan, and her network of contacts may prove useful in your search for knowledge. I wish you all the best in your pursuits, wheresoever they may take you.

57.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_000530_THANCRED
57.description: Glad you could join us. I hope you don't mind, but we went ahead and started without you.

58.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_000540_YSHTOLA
58.description: As you can imagine, our traveling companions were eager to become acquainted. 'Tis a rare thing indeed to see such a diverse and talented group of individuals assembled for a single purpose.

59.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_000550_YSHTOLA
59.description: We fight not only for the sake of Eorzea, but for the entire world─including the people of Garlemald. Much rides on the efforts of the Ilsabard contingent.

60.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_000560_LUCIA
60.description: Indeed. Which is why I am glad to find myself in the company of many trusted comrades─yourselves included.

62.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_000580_LUCIA
62.description: I have come at the behest of Lord Aymeric, who has honored me with the role of Ishgard's representative. For the good of all nations, not least my former homeland, I am determined to see this mission through to its end.

63.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_000590_LUCIA
63.description: We have a hard road ahead of us, but walk it we shall. Together.

64.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_000600_ALPHINAUD
64.description: We too welcome this opportunity to work together once more. I have faith that, if there is a way to resolve this conflict, we will find it.

65.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_000610_LUCIA
65.description: Allow me to introduce you to the rest of our company.

66.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_000620_LUCIA
66.description: Everyone, if I may have your attention!

67.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_000630_LUCIA
67.description: Might I ask you to speak first?

69.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_000650_ARUHNSENNA
69.description: I am A<hex:021F0103>Ruhn<hex:021F0103>Senna, spokesman for the Gridanian delegation, here on behalf of my esteemed sister, the Elder Seedseer.

70.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_000660_ARUHNSENNA
70.description: We shall provide support and protection to those in need during our time in Garlemald.

71.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_000670_ARUHNSENNA
71.description: To that end, I am joined by healers selected by the Conjurers' Guild, with the Order of the Twin Adder's finest serving as our escort.

72.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_000680_ARUHNSENNA
72.description: Of course, with an experienced white mage such as yourself accompanying us as well, those requiring more involved treatment will be in safe hands. Raya<hex:021F0103>O sends her regards, by the way.

73.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_000690_SICARD
73.description: S'pose I'd better say my piece...

75.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_000710_SICARD
75.description: The name's Sicard, in case you've forgotten. Truth be told, I'd rather you had forgotten...

76.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_000720_SICARD
76.description: Anyroad, the Admiral asked Captain Hyllfyr to send his best, and for whatever reason, he picked me.

77.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_000730_SICARD
77.description: 'Course, if I'd refused, I'd be the laughin' stock of the Bloody Executioners, and my reputation's taken enough of a keelhaulin' as it is. But more importantly, like any pirate worth his salt, I know when you're starin' down a storm, you've got to trust in the commander of your ship.

78.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_000740_SICARD
78.description: So if the Admiral wants us to go to Garlemald─not for plunder and glory, but the promise of peace in our time─then that's what we'll do!

79.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_000750_SICARD
79.description: Since we all know how much the Empire loves its steel, we thought we'd bring along a few smiths to make the most of it. Give 'em a pile of scrap and they'll cobble together anythin' you fancy.

80.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_000760_SICARD
80.description: 'Course, just like the Gridanians, we've got fighters of our own. We might've come with a more constructive purpose in mind, but we're more'n capable of cracking skulls, believe you me.

81.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_000770_LYSE
81.description: Well, you're certainly raring to go. But then again, so are we.

82.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_000780_LYSE
82.description: The most dependable warriors of Ul'dah and Ala Mhigo have assembled at the sultana and General Aldynn's behest.

83.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_000790_LYSE
83.description: If Garlemald has truly fallen, then the whole place is likely to be crawling with Telophoroi. We'll need plenty of troops to clear and hold a path for others to follow.

84.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_000800_LYSE
84.description: That's where we come in. Naturally, Marshal Tarupin and I will be leading from the front.

85.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_000810_YSHTOLA
85.description: It's been some time since I last saw you in your element on the battlefield.

86.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_000820_LYSE
86.description: From what I've heard, you've become pretty fearsome yourself. “Master Matoya,” the “avatar of destruction.”

88.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_000830_LYSE
88.description: With comrades like these, I know we'll succeed, no matter what awaits us.

89.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_000840_LYSE
89.description: And then we might finally get a chance to enjoy a good long rest. But until then, let's give it our all!

90.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_000850_LUCIA
90.description: As for Ishgard, we Temple Knights have come in force to uphold our nation's commitment to the peace and welfare of our allies.

91.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_000860_LUCIA
91.description: The bitter cold of Garlemald is a formidable enemy in of itself. Our experience fighting in ice and snow will prove invaluable in the days ahead.

92.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_000870_LUCIA
92.description: Accordingly, I have been designated commander of the Ilsabard contingent. I will do all in my power to provide you with the leadership and guidance you require.

93.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_000880_LUCIA
93.description: The four High Houses─House Haillenarte foremost among them─have arranged for a host of machinists to join us on our mission.

94.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_000890_LUCIA
94.description: Their knowledge of imperial magitek is sure to be a great boon. They will address any problems of a technical nature, together with the smiths of Limsa Lominsa.

97.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_000920_EMMANELLAIN
97.description: Ah, yes... Emmanellain de Fortemps, at your service.

98.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_000930_EMMANELLAIN
98.description: Though...lest there be any misunderstanding, I should stress that I've not become a “fearsome” warrior while you were away. Rather far from it, actually. My brother, in his infinite wisdom, decided this would be an excellent chance to make something of myself... Oh, and fight for world peace and all that.

99.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_000940_EMMANELLAIN
99.description: But should the opportunity arise for a spot of ballroom dancing, I will be your twinkle-toed Gentleman of Light!

101.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_A2_000_001_NONE_VOICE
101.description: May your graceful prancing lead the way to victory!

102.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_A2_000_002_NONE_VOICE
102.description: I daresay your fancy footwork may be all that stands between us and certain doom.

103.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_000950_EMMANELLAIN
103.description: Huzzah! I cannot wait to regale Honoroit with my tales of derring-do!

104.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_000960_LUCIA
104.description: I believe that concludes introductions for the Grand Company of Eorzea.

105.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_000970_LUCIA
105.description: Our allies from the Eastern alliance were due to arrive some time ago, but it would appear they have been delayed...

106.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_000980_ALISAIE
106.description: Would that be the shinobi of Doma?

107.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_000990_THANCRED
107.description: Actually, they've been tasked with relaying messages back and forth between the various Eastern nations. According to Lord Hien, however, an equally capable company of warriors has been sent in their stead...

108.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_001000_SADU
108.description: (-???-)Out of my way, you preening fool!

109.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_001010_CIRINA
109.description: Forgive us for coming late! We are the delegates of the Eastern alliance.

111.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_001030_SADU
111.description: For battle and blood we come, as the Steppe is sorely lacking in both. No towers befoul our lands, so we marched on those of Doma─only to find them beyond our reach.

112.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_001040_SADU
112.description: But now our thirst for slaughter will be slaked. No quarter to the enemy!

113.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_001050_CIRINA
113.description: Sadu Khatun, no! We go to make peace with the ironmen, not war.

114.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_001060_LUCIA
114.description: Warriors of the Steppe, we have heard many tales of your bravery. We welcome you as allies. And these other ones you have brought are...?

115.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_001070_CIRINA
115.description: Members of the Dalmascan resistance group, Lente's Tears.

117.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_001090_THANCRED
117.description: Between them, they have a wealth of experience in espionage, and are particularly adept at infiltrating imperial facilities. Which is fortuitous, since Garlemald's domain is so vast that I could never hope to handle reconnaissance duties all by myself.

118.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_001100_ALPHINAUD
118.description: Dalmasca, Bozja, Ala Mhigo... All lands which have suffered the tyranny of the Empire.

119.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_001110_ALPHINAUD
119.description: I would never presume to question your motives. Nevertheless, I must reiterate that our goal is to aid the victims of the Telophoroi. The commonfolk of Garlemald.

120.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_001120_ALPHINAUD
120.description: And they are victims, make no mistake. Though I understand that many may struggle to see them as such...

121.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_001130_LYSE
121.description: You're more right than you know. For every one of us that answered the call, there were a dozen that refused.

122.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_001140_LYSE
122.description: Not only in Ala Mhigo, but everywhere we went. And who could blame them? The Empire's always been “the enemy.”

123.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_001150_LYSE
123.description: But after seeing what we've seen...fighting and working against─and with─Garleans, there's no denying the simple truth.

124.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_001160_LYSE
124.description: They're just people. No different from you or I. They've got their share of liars and murderers, but so do we. So do we all.

125.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_001170_LYSE
125.description: Fordola, who once swore herself to Garlemald, has proven herself a trusted ally time and time again. Every Eorzean here knows Cid Garlond, the imperial defector who shared with us countless technological wonders.

126.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_001180_LYSE
126.description: Gaius bloody Baelsar himself is working to help rebuild Werlyt, a nation he once conquered.

127.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_001190_LYSE
127.description: Maxima, who stands with us today, tried to reform Garlemald from within and make peace with Doma.

128.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_001200_LYSE
128.description: So you can believe me when I say that every fighter here understands and accepts that the imperials are not monsters and are deserving of help. Or at least that they were able to put aside their feelings for the greater good.

129.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_001210_LYSE
129.description: It won't be easy, but we're all determined to make this world a better place.

130.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_001220_ALPHINAUD
130.description: What lingering concerns I may have had were clearly unwarranted. I agree with everything you said wholeheartedly.

131.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_001230_LUCIA
131.description: Then we are in accord. Now─let us review our strategy.

132.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_001240_LUCIA
132.description: To reach the Garlean capital in northern Ilsabard, we must cross the central mountain range.

133.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_001250_LUCIA
133.description: Fortunately, Garlond Ironworks can provide aerial transport, sparing us this most treacherous part of our journey.

134.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_001260_LUCIA
134.description: However, attempting to fly any closer to Garlemald would attract the attention of the Telophoroi.

135.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_001270_LUCIA
135.description: As they appear to have seized control of the majority of the imperial military, we must assume that includes its fleet. In addition, Garlemald possesses devices that can interfere with airship navigational systems, further discouraging an airborne approach.

136.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_001280_MAXIMA
136.description: Given the circumstances, the closest we dare deploy our contingent is an area between the range and the capital─the Magna Glacies.

137.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_001290_MAXIMA
137.description: From there, we must travel the rest of the way on foot. We will also need to bring the airships with us to ensure we can withdraw with haste. Although much of the terrain will be blanketed in snow, we should be able to make use of local roads and shipping facilities.

138.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_001300_MAXIMA
138.description: The vast ice field will afford us an unobstructed view of the surrounding area. On the other hand, it will also allow others to easily spot us, so it is imperative that we only make camp in positions where we can easily defend ourselves─and the airships, which must be kept safe at all costs.

139.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_001310_LUCIA
139.description: We cannot account for every possibility, so we must be prepared to think on our feet. We will be tested. Sorely tested, I expect. But for our homes and for our people─and a people not our own but in need─we will succeed.

140.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_001320_LUCIA
140.description: Spare no effort in your preparations. Once we depart, there is no turning back.

141.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_001330_EMETSELCH
141.description: Ilsabard...divided in twain by a vast mountain range.

142.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_001340_EMETSELCH
142.description: Those who would traverse its jagged peaks face peril at every step. But why go by foot when one can simply fly?

143.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_001350_EMETSELCH
143.description: On the outskirts of the imperial capital, in the frozen wastes of the Magna Glacies...

144.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_001360_EMETSELCH
144.description: The winds howl in icy protest, as if to warn against further trespass...

145.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_001370_LUCIA
145.description: We've received word from Thancred's reconnaissance party.

146.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_001380_LUCIA
146.description: They have sighted a detachment of heavily armed imperials.

147.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_001390_ALISAIE
147.description: Survivors of the civil war, perhaps?

148.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_001400_LUCIA
148.description: Perhaps. But there is more to it than that...

149.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_001410_LUCIA
149.description: Maxima reports that they are led by Vergilia, legatus of the IIIrd Legion, which comprises the bulk of their number.

150.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_001420_LUCIA
150.description: However, they are also joined by several members of the Ist.

151.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_001430_ALPHINAUD
151.description: From what I recall, the IIIrd Legion fought for Nerva in the war of succession following Varis's death.

152.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_001440_ALPHINAUD
152.description: The Ist, on the other hand, were under the direct command of the Emperor, and rejected Nerva's claim to the throne. These legions were enemies.

153.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_001450_LUCIA
153.description: Indeed. In fact, our sources claim that it was a conflict between them that sparked the civil war.

154.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_001460_LUCIA
154.description: Yet now these former foes cooperate to defend a ruined Garlemald from invasion...

155.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_001470_ALPHINAUD
155.description: Then it is all but certain they have been tempered.

156.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_001480_SICARD
156.description: So what's the plan? If me and my crew was out reavin', we'd charge straight in, no messin' about. But that ain't what we're here for.

157.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_001490_LUCIA
157.description: Quite right. Soldiers or no, they are people of Garlemald. The very ones we have come to aid.

158.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_001500_LUCIA
158.description: Direct confrontation is unavoidable. Nevertheless, we must make every effort to limit casualties on both sides. Rather than kill them, I would remove them from the field.

159.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_001510_ARUHNSENNA
159.description: How so? Savage beatings, disarmament, and imprisonment?

160.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_001520_ARUHNSENNA
160.description: Not impossible, but easier said than done in the heat of battle.

161.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_001530_URIANGER
161.description: Having observed the opposition, I imagine Thancred had something to suggest?

162.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_001540_LUCIA
162.description: He did. He and the other scouts have already infiltrated a supply depot some distance beyond the imperial detachment's current position.

163.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_001550_LUCIA
163.description: Stored within is a stockpile of magitek armaments, and once we give the signal, Thancred's team will destroy them all. In so doing, we will deprive frontline troops of materiel, and likely force the detachment to send men to investigate.

164.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_001560_ARUHNSENNA
164.description: Divide and conquer... Not a bad idea.

165.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_001570_LUCIA
165.description: Once the scouts have finished their preparations, we will split into two groups.

166.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_001580_LUCIA
166.description: The first will form the vanguard, while the other brings up the rear with our supplies.

167.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_001590_LUCIA
167.description: As for the Scions, I ask that you lend your assistance where you deem it needed most.

168.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_001600_LUCIA
168.description: I would prefer, however, that you accompany the rear guard, and be prepared to join the van at a moment's notice. Kept in reserve as our trump card, so to speak.

169.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_001610_SYSTEM_NONE_VOICE
169.description: Meanwhile, at the imperial supply depot...

170.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_001620_MAXIMA
170.description: Your proposal was well received. More specifically, they asked that we “destroy the imperials' toys in as spectacular a fashion as possible.”

171.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_001630_THANCRED
171.description: Y'shtola always did have a flair for the dramatic. She's not an easy woman to please, but I shall do my best to satisfy her thirst for fireworks.

172.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_001640_THANCRED
172.description: All right. Once more, for my peace of mind.

173.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_001650_THANCRED
173.description: Our first objective will be to rig the enemy's magitek with explosives. After we've withdrawn to a safe distance, we'll detonate them remotely.

174.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_001660_THANCRED
174.description: Our second will be to issue a deactivation command to the automated units via the control terminal. If our calculations are correct, this signal should reach those deployed on the front line, giving our friends a much-needed upper hand.

175.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_001670_THANCRED
175.description: The blizzard will help us stay hidden, so let's aim to get in and out before it passes. Trust in the plan, and we should all live to see tomorrow.

176.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_001680_MAXIMA
176.description: In the meantime, I will relay messages back and forth as the situation unfolds. You'll forgive me if I ask again, but...are you certain you wish to play the lone wolf?

177.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_001690_THANCRED
177.description: Wouldn't have it any other way. Call it foolish and reckless if you like, but I'll get the job done. I always do.

178.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_001700_MAXIMA
178.description: Very well. I wish you the best of luck.

179.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_001710_THANCRED
179.description: It's time. We only have one shot at this, so let's make it count!

180.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_001720_MAXIMA
180.description: You are returned─and none the worse for wear, to my considerable relief.

183.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_001750_THANCRED
183.description: Excellent. Then let the fireworks begin!

184.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_001760_SYSTEM_NONE_VOICE
184.description: A few moments later, at the rear of the Ilsabard contingent's supply caravan...

186.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_001780_ALISAIE
186.description: The vanguard should be engaging the imperials any moment now─if they haven't already.

187.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_001790_ALISAIE
187.description: Y'shtola and the others are with them, so I'm sure they'll be all right, but...

190.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_001820_SICARD
190.description: Oi, oi! Looks like we ain't the only ones who sent out scouts!

191.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_001830_SICARD
191.description: Keep 'em away from the carriages! We lose those, and we're as good as dead!

194.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_001860_YSHTOLA
194.description: “Remove from the field” was not a euphemism for “enthusiastically murder.”

195.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_001870_ESTINIEN
195.description: It's nothing that won't heal. In time.

196.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_001880_ESTINIEN
196.description: The trouble is, their tempering has made them utterly fearless. Subduing them would be easier if they had the capacity to submit in the first place.

197.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_001890_YSHTOLA
197.description: Well, this is the path our young charges would have us walk─and that we all agreed to follow. You knew it would be hard, yet still you pledged your lance, did you not?

200.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_001910_LYSE
200.description: That's Vergilia! Damn it, I need to help the others take her down─

202.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_001930_LYSE
202.description: I was wondering when you'd turn up!

203.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_001940_LYSE
203.description: There's no stopping us now! Come on, let's show them what we're made of!

205.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_001960_SADU
205.description: Rest. Recover. Reclaim yourself. Then we will fight again─to the death.

207.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_001980_LUCIA
207.description: That was the last of them...

208.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_001990_LUCIA
208.description: The day is ours, thanks to your timely arrival. What of the supply caravan?

209.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_002000_LUCIA
209.description: Hmm. Outmaneuvered, but not outmatched. Good. Let us take the imperials into custody and rejoin our comrades.

210.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_002010_LUCIA
210.description: And soon we shall arrive at the capital...

211.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_002020_EMETSELCH
211.description: “So cold and unforgiving.” Thus spoke Emperor Solus as he gazed upon his barren domain.

212.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_002030_EMETSELCH
212.description: Eight hundred years it had been since the Garleans first set foot here.

213.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_002040_EMETSELCH
213.description: Bested by the Corvosi after centuries of war and driven from fertile southern pastures into the blasted northern wastes.

214.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_002050_EMETSELCH
214.description: In that garden of desolation, they clung to one another for warmth. Freezing, hungry, desperate. Hated.

216.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_002070_EMETSELCH
216.description: In the year 1513 of the Sixth Astral Era, a young legatus named Solus single-handedly sparked the magitek revolution.

217.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_002080_EMETSELCH
217.description: How did he conceive the machina that feed on ceruleum?

218.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_002090_EMETSELCH
218.description: Once a common, soft-spoken soldier─how had he so quickly ascended through the ranks?

219.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_002100_EMETSELCH
219.description: Like so many others, those who knew the truth are gone.

220.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_002110_EMETSELCH
220.description: Taking in the capital with his eyes for the first time, I recall thinking to myself...

221.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_002120_EMETSELCH
221.description: “Far colder on the earth than in the heavens.” Yes, far colder indeed...bitterly so.

222.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_002130_MAXIMA
222.description: Not so much as a whisper...

223.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_002140_LUCIA
223.description: The roads leading beyond the city walls would have been used less in recent years. Nevertheless, this was one of the most important gateways into the capital.

224.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_002150_MAXIMA
224.description: Abuzz day and night with activity, aye. Merchants passing through the checkpoint, many of them stopping at the local hostelries.

225.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_002160_LUCIA
225.description: Surely, they cannot <hex:021A020203>all<hex:021A020103> have been tempered...

226.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_002170_ARUHNSENNA
226.description: We can consider the question after we have made camp.

227.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_002180_ARUHNSENNA
227.description: If we spend any longer outside, we may well freeze to death where we stand. The tempered imperials, too.

228.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_002190_LUCIA
228.description: This will be our temporary base of operations. Secure shelter for ourselves and the injured, and dispatch scouts to survey the surrounding area.

229.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_002200_SICARD
229.description: If we're plannin' on stayin' here a while, we ought to give this place a proper name.

230.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_002210_LUCIA
230.description: Hmm... The constant sound of ice cracking underfoot makes me think of broken glass. An apt name, perhaps. But enough of this. To work, everyone!

231.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_002220_LUCIA
231.description: Our present situation is as follows.

232.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_002230_LUCIA
232.description: Efforts to aid the people of Garlemald have begun in earnest. Moreover, having entered into the capital, the imperial palace is within our reach.

233.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_002240_YSHTOLA
233.description: But before we proceed further, we must learn what has befallen this city, for therein lies the key to understanding and combating the Telophoroi's designs.

234.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_002250_MAXIMA
234.description: I have a suggestion, if I may.

235.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_002260_MAXIMA
235.description: Several of the imperial soldiers we captured on the Magna Glacies are members of the Populares and acquaintances of mine.

236.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_002270_MAXIMA
236.description: Once we have cured them of their tempering, they should be able to give a reliable account of the events leading to the capital's downfall.

237.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_002280_YSHTOLA
237.description: A promising idea. I will assist the healers in their ministrations.

238.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_002290_YSHTOLA
238.description: Of course, I will require a porxie of my own, assuming you can spare one.

240.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_002310_YSHTOLA
240.description: No, no, I am sure we will manage. Better that you take my place in the field. The noxious aether of this place disagrees with me, and as I shall need to draw on my own for the treatment, 'twould be prudent for me to remain within the camp.

241.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_002320_SICARD
241.description: This talk of curin' the tempered is all well and good, but I reckon the cold is a more pressin' concern.

242.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_002330_SICARD
242.description: All the houses 'round here are fitted with ceruleum heaters that could keep us warm and toasty. Problem is, the machines seem to have given up the ghost─and if we keep sittin' around, freezin' our arses off, we'll be next.

243.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_002340_SICARD
243.description: My smiths reckon that with the right parts, they can have 'em workin' again, but it won't be easy.

244.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_002350_LUCIA
244.description: Understood. The machinists will assist them in the repairs.

245.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_002360_THANCRED
245.description: The rest of us should either stand watch or survey the area.

246.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_002370_LUCIA
246.description: We have made our presence known to the Telophoroi. They will be searching for us─if they have not already ascertained our position.

247.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_002380_LUCIA
247.description: That we have seen no sign of them since the battle suggests they have yet to do so. However, I suspect they may be biding their time...

248.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_002390_ESTINIEN
248.description: ...Or perhaps we are beneath their notice.

249.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_002400_THANCRED
249.description: In any event, we'll find no answers standing around here. Urianger, Estinien, and myself have visited Garlemald recently, so we'll lead the reconnaissance efforts. Perhaps bolstered by a few Bozjan and Dalmascan scouts from my previous excursion for good measure.

250.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_002410_LYSE
250.description: Don't forget about us Ala Mhigans. We have experienced scouts of our own.

251.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_002420_THANCRED
251.description: Well now, this is turning out to be a rather sizable team. With such numbers we should be able to cover a wide area with relative ease, including that surrounding the imperial palace.

252.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_002430_THANCRED
252.description: How about you, G'raha? I've a feeling we'll find a use or two for that vanishing spell of yours.

253.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_002440_GRAHATIA
253.description: 'Twould be my honor to be of service, though I doubt that you of all people need rely on my tricks.

254.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_002450_ALISAIE
254.description: That leaves us with guard duty...

255.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_002460_LUCIA
255.description: As a matter of fact, I have something else in mind for the two of you and Alphinaud.

256.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_002470_LUCIA
256.description: Between here and the center of the capital lies the Eblan Rime. I would have you search the area for survivors.

257.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_002480_LUCIA
257.description: Your keen sense of direction honed in your extensive travels should prove useful in navigating the ice fields.

259.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_A3_000_001_NONE_VOICE
259.description: If there are any survivors, we will surely find them.

260.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_A3_000_002_NONE_VOICE
260.description: “Extensive travels” is something of an understatement, but I suppose if there's nothing else that needs doing...

261.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_A3_000_003_NONE_VOICE
261.description: Ice fields! I love ice fields! ...Oh wait, no I don't.

262.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_002490_LUCIA
262.description: I have faith that you will, and look forward to greeting you on your safe return.

263.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_002500_LUCIA
263.description: This too is a vital task, and I appreciate your willingness to see it done. Rest assured that a serving of hot soup will be waiting for you.

264.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_002510_LUCIA
264.description: Hmm. As ever, you do not want for enthusiasm. But given your experience traipsing about through Coerthas, I should be surprised if you let a little inclement weather dampen your redoubtable spirits.

265.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_002520_LUCIA
265.description: And even if that were the case, the promise of hot soup upon your return would surely spur you to action.

266.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_002530_LUCIA
266.description: You all have your duties. Let us make haste. May the Fury bless and keep you.

269.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_002560_ALISAIE
269.description: Blood trail... We found one. They were attacked...

273.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_002600_ALPHINAUD
273.description: Safer to brave the wilds than trust in our magic.

275.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_002620_ALPHINAUD
275.description: We can't leave them like this. We have to take them home.

276.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_002630_ALISAIE
276.description: What if we're only making it worse?

277.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_002640_ALPHINAUD
277.description: Maybe we don't belong here. But neither do they. Not out here in the wind and the cold.

278.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_002650_ALPHINAUD
278.description: I heard the story. About Varis's voice. From beyond the grave...

279.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_002660_ALPHINAUD
279.description: Of course, I didn't believe it. But Licinia and her sister did. Perhaps there is something to the tale after all.

280.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_002670_ALPHINAUD
280.description: I want to understand. So I'm going to borrow this for a while. If that's all right.

281.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_002680_ALPHINAUD
281.description: You had every reason not to trust us. We came as trespassers. Invaders.

282.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_002690_ALPHINAUD
282.description: But I pray that, in time, we will be more than that to you. That we will find a way to help your loved ones...and see that no more children are left to freeze alone in the snow.

284.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_002710_LUCIA
284.description: We shall inform the troops of these developments, and instruct them to proceed with the utmost caution should they encounter any survivors.

285.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_002720_MAXIMA
285.description: Allow me to go and speak with the ones at the Victors' Spoils. They may be more willing to listen to a fellow Garlean and accept our offer of assistance.

286.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_002730_ALPHINAUD
286.description: I pray you are right. And though I am loath to burden you any further, should there be an appropriate occasion to speak of Licinia and her sister...please do so.

287.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_002740_LUCIA
287.description: I am sorry to have put you through this.

288.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_002750_ALISAIE
288.description: My distress is nothing compared to their suffering...

289.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_002760_ALISAIE
289.description: So tell me: what else have we learned?

290.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_002770_YSHTOLA
290.description: As you may have already heard, we have succeeded in curing the members of the Populares Maxima identified.

291.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_002780_YSHTOLA
291.description: They have provided us with some intriguing insights into the current state of Garlemald.

292.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_002790_YSHTOLA
292.description: The assassination of Emperor Varis was the catalyst for the civil war. Nerva declared his claim to the throne, and his opponents refused to recognize it.

293.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_002800_YSHTOLA
293.description: Fighting broke out in the capital, where Nerva's IIIrd Legion clashed with the Ist, who remained loyal to Varis even after his death.

294.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_002810_ARUHNSENNA
294.description: Of course, even imperial warmongers would balk at the idea of turning their shining city into a battleground. Like burning down the wood to spite the wasps. Neither side would be so mad.

295.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_002820_ARUHNSENNA
295.description: Unless something or <hex:021A020203>someone<hex:021A020103> inflamed their animosity to such an extent that they could not help but act against their better judgment.

296.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_002830_LUCIA
296.description: It brings to mind events at the Ghimlyt Dark, does it not? The Emperor's sudden withdrawal from the front lines, specifically.

297.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_002840_LUCIA
297.description: Nerva and his father, Titus─Varis's then political rival─took advantage of rumors that Crown Prince Zenos had been possessed by a demon.

298.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_002850_ALISAIE
298.description: Elidibus. What better way to disparage your enemies than with the truth─or a close enough approximation.

299.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_002860_LUCIA
299.description: Indeed. But before their accusations could be substantiated, many of Titus's followers were silenced.

300.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_002870_LUCIA
300.description: While some were merely stripped of their status, others died under curious circumstances. One after another, suddenly and suspiciously.

301.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_002880_YSHTOLA
301.description: Again, Elidibus. Like as not, he had a hand in it. No evidence was found to implicate Varis, certainly.

302.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_002890_YSHTOLA
302.description: Nevertheless, Titus, Nerva, and the IIIrd Legion would have judged it a brazen attempt by the Emperor to rid himself of his political enemies.

303.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_002900_YSHTOLA
303.description: And then, in the midst of this growing turmoil, Varis zos Galvus is murdered...

304.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_002910_YSHTOLA
304.description: And Garlemald's own prodigal son, Gaius van Baelsar, is named the murderer.

305.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_002920_YSHTOLA
305.description: Shortly thereafter, Nerva claims the right of succession, and in response, the Ist Legion claims the assassination was part of a coup d'état orchestrated by Titus and Nerva.

306.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_002930_ALPHINAUD
306.description: So no one is at fault and everyone else is to blame.

307.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_002940_MAXIMA
307.description: I should add that both parties received substantial financial backing─presumably to provide them with the means and encouragement to pursue a swift victory─and that these contributions came from the selfsame benefactor.

308.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_002950_ALISAIE
308.description: I'd heard House Brutus had been filling the IIIrd Legion's coffers, but the Ist as well?

309.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_002960_MAXIMA
309.description: It would seem so. Though the Populares determined that the Ist Legion received funds from a variety of organizations, all had connections to House Brutus.

310.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_002970_ALPHINAUD
310.description: So Fandaniel, in the guise of Asahi, was playing both sides against each other the entire time!

311.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_002980_MAXIMA
311.description: The information we gained from my friends does not end there. One night shortly after fighting broke out, the capital was shaken by an immense tremor.

312.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_002990_MAXIMA
312.description: From that point onward, they have no memories─no recollection of any events, including our clash on the Magna Glacies.

313.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_003000_MAXIMA
313.description: But when asked about the imperial palace and its bizarre transformation, they somehow recall Emperor Varis giving them orders. In their dreams.

314.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_003010_MAXIMA
314.description: “May the Tower of Babil stand as testament to the glory of Garlemald!”

316.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_003030_ALPHINAUD
316.description: We have something to show you all.

317.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_003040_MAXIMA
317.description: Varis spoke to them through this radio...? Perhaps it was a recording, but if not, that would be...inexplicable.

318.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_003050_YSHTOLA
318.description: We are of one mind, then.

319.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_003060_ARUHNSENNA
319.description: The aether that permeates the ore used in this device is almost identical to that of the talismans.

320.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_003070_YSHTOLA
320.description: I see it... While it is likely more by coincidence than design, these devices might also ward against a primal's influence.

321.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_003080_YSHTOLA
321.description: A picture is beginning to form. If the tremor felt throughout Garlemald was a wave of aether emitted by a primal...

322.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_003090_YSHTOLA
322.description: ...Then while those within range would have been tempered, those huddled around a radio─desperate for news concerning the civil war─would have been spared.

323.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_003100_ALPHINAUD
323.description: No wonder Licinia kept it close...

324.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_003110_CIRINA
324.description: My friends! I must speak with you!

325.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_003120_CIRINA
325.description: A young man was caught trying to steal our supplies. He is a soldier of the ironmen, we think, but one who has not been made thrall.

326.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_003130_CIRINA
326.description: Thankfully, Magnai restrained him before blood was spilled. The stranger is outside, if you wish to ask him questions.

330.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_003170_JULLUS
330.description: (-???-)Traitors to your homeland! Have you no shame!?

331.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_003180_LUCIA
331.description: I am Lucia Junius, a Temple Knight of Ishgard. And you are?

332.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_003190_JULLUS
332.description: Jullus pyr Norbanus. And that's all you invaders will get from me.

333.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_003200_LUCIA
333.description: We are not here to invade Garlemald. Far from it.

334.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_003210_LUCIA
334.description: Like you, our allies in Eorzea and the Far East fight in defense of their lives and their loved ones, even as we speak.

335.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_003220_LUCIA
335.description: But it is the people of Garlemald who have suffered most. This we know. And that is why we have come to offer you our aid, that we may unite against our common foe.

336.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_003230_LUCIA
336.description: Whether you believe me or not, those are the facts. Now, answer me this.

337.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_003240_LUCIA
337.description: Why would a proud soldier of the Empire be reduced to stealing? The situation must be dire indeed for you to go to such lengths.

339.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_003260_LUCIA
339.description: If it is supplies you seek, we would gladly share ours. Or turn a blind eye while you leave with your “spoils.”

340.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_003270_JULLUS
340.description: I will not negotiate. My commander will determine how to deal with you and yours.

341.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_003280_JULLUS
341.description: If you wish to treat with him, I will take you. But no more than three.

342.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_003290_YSHTOLA
342.description: I don't much like the sound of that, but if we do accept his proposal, I suggest the two of us and...

343.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_003300_ALPHINAUD
343.description: Please allow me and Alisaie to act as envoys.

345.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_003320_ALPHINAUD
345.description: We have seen with our own eyes the hardships the Garleans face. How their futures and lives hang in the balance.

346.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_003330_ALISAIE
346.description: It's not the warmest invitation, but it's an opportunity to prove our intentions true. Maybe not a chance to make things right, but a chance to...make them better.

349.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_A4_000_002_NONE_VOICE
349.description: What would your mother say if I let you two go by yourselves?

350.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_003340_LUCIA
350.description: I can see that persuading you otherwise is a lost cause. But you will proceed with the utmost care.

351.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_003350_JULLUS
351.description: A couple of children and what─a sellsword? Is this an insult?

352.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_003360_LUCIA
352.description: Not in the least. You will find that they are more than qualified to speak on our behalf.

353.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_003370_JULLUS
353.description: There are many dangers on the road ahead. I will need that back.

355.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_003390_QUINTUS
355.description: (-Imposing Commander-)Very well. Let us hear what they have to say.

357.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_003410_JULLUS
357.description: I present to you our commander...

358.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_003420_JULLUS
358.description: ...Lord Quintus van Cinna, legatus of the Ist Legion.

359.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_003430_ALPHINAUD
359.description: The Ist? I had no idea you had survived!

360.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_003440_QUINTUS
360.description: We lost our Emperor, our city, more than half our troops. For my wounds, I may never take the field again. But we survived, aye.

361.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_003450_QUINTUS
361.description: In a manner much to your liking, I daresay.

362.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_003460_ALPHINAUD
362.description: We have no intention of adding to your misfortunes. Nor do we bear you any ill will.

363.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_003470_QUINTUS
363.description: Spare me. Though you children may speak in earnest, overtures of peace ever ring hollow in my ears. So long as man stands to profit from his neighbor's suffering, war is inevitable.

364.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_003480_QUINTUS
364.description: Driven from our ancestral homeland into this blasted waste. Yet still you yearned to rob us of our paltry scraps.

365.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_003490_QUINTUS
365.description: 'Twas only with magitek that you learned to keep your distance. Though we knew it was only a matter of time before you regrouped and returned.

366.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_003500_QUINTUS
366.description: Conquest and empire were our only defenses. Emperors Solus and Varis understood this, and through their campaigns saw us grow and prosper. Much blood has been spilled in Garlemald's name, aye, but if it is a choice between yours and mine, then it is hardly a choice at all.

367.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_003510_ALPHINAUD
367.description: I do not deny that a great many conflicts throughout history were driven by the desire─or necessity─to gain by another's loss. That is not why we are here.

368.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_003520_ALPHINAUD
368.description: Nor have we come to petition your aid in the war with the Telophoroi, grave though that threat may be. Our purpose is simply this:

369.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_003530_ALPHINAUD
369.description: We wish to help you. Let us help you. If there is aught that can be done to ease your plight, we would be glad to do it.

371.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_003550_QUINTUS
371.description: But regardless of the ideals you espouse, your leaders would not send an army into Garlemald if they did not stand to benefit.

372.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_003560_QUINTUS
372.description: If we accept their aid, they will expect their efforts to be rewarded once the Telophoroi are no longer a threat.

373.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_003570_QUINTUS
373.description: And after compensation and concessions, the great Empire would be brought to heel. Her enemies rejoice at her downfall. Our third eye a mark of shame.

374.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_003580_ALISAIE
374.description: We won't stand idly by and let your people be humiliated─and we're not alone in that. We only want to make a difference─to make this world of ours better. Surely you can understand that.

375.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_003590_ALISAIE
375.description: What I'm trying to say is...there are so, so many people who just don't care about making you suffer. And maybe that's almost insulting after all the suffering you feel the world has subjected your people to, but...

376.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_003600_ALISAIE
376.description: Believe it or not, that's the truth. And now we're here, and all we're asking is for you to tell us what you want. What you hope for.

377.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_003610_ALPHINAUD
377.description: So much blood has been shed. So much lost. All because of this endless war. Who wouldn't want to end it?

378.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_003620_ALPHINAUD
378.description: Can we not work together, to face our problems as one?

380.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_003640_QUINTUS
380.description: If a world without conflict is your desire, why reject the unity and prosperity of Garlemald?

381.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_003650_QUINTUS
381.description: Is it because we do not share your faith?

382.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_003660_QUINTUS
382.description: That we do not share your heritage?

383.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_003670_QUINTUS
383.description: That our ideals and virtues differ? That we cherish and hold in the highest that which you do not?

384.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_003680_QUINTUS
384.description: Disparity is the root of discord, and peace built on compromise is flawed and fleeting. Happiness for one and all is a dream, and the reality is that to the victor go the spoils.

385.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_003690_QUINTUS
385.description: That is why we Garleans will never submit nor surrender. For freedom and for pride, we will remain true to ourselves until the bitter end. That is my hope.

386.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_003700_QUINTUS
386.description: It seems there is nothing more to say on the matter.

387.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_003710_QUINTUS
387.description: You will remain here while I decide what is to be done with you. Do not be alarmed. No harm will come to you─if you cooperate.

388.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_003720_ALPHINAUD
388.description: We will not resist. However, as your “guests,” I ask that we be allowed to speak with the other members of your group.

389.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_003730_QUINTUS
389.description: As you wish. I had no intention of locking you up, as by dawn you would be frozen stiff, and you are no good to me dead. You are free to move about the encampment. But there is one condition.

392.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_003760_QUINTUS
392.description: Incentive. You will be watched at all times. Stray too far or act suspiciously and we will administer a rather painful shock.

393.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_003770_QUINTUS
393.description: Stop. Keep away from that one.

394.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_003780_QUINTUS
394.description: The champion of Eorzea is not so easily cowed.

395.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_003790_QUINTUS
395.description: Even if <hex:02080CE905FF04736865FF03686503> allowed <hex:020815E905FF0868657273656C66FF0868696D73656C6603> to be collared, the shock would be no more than an itch. No─if <hex:02080CE905FF04736865FF03686503> refuses to obey, we will activate the twins' restraints instead.

397.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_003810_ALISAIE
397.description: We'll forget we're even wearing them soon enough.

398.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_003820_QUINTUS
398.description: Even now, you still... Why go to such lengths? What is it all for?

400.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_A5_000_001_NONE_VOICE
400.description: Because even the most bitter adversary may one day see reason.

401.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_A5_000_002_NONE_VOICE
401.description: On the coldest, blackest of nights...meager though it may be, we must share the warmth of our fire.

402.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_003830_QUINTUS
402.description: You are a curious one. A far cry from the merciless barbarian others paint you to be.

403.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_003840_QUINTUS
403.description: You will be their warden. Take them away.

405.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_003860_THANCRED
405.description: Finally escaped the watchful gaze of your keepers, have we?

406.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_003870_THANCRED
406.description: Don't react. You'll only draw attention to yourself. Just carry on as you are and listen.

407.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_003880_THANCRED
407.description: After you left with the Garlean lad, Lucia bade a few of us scouts follow you at a discreet distance.

408.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_003890_THANCRED
408.description: We observed you being led into the station, but decided against venturing inside.

409.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_003900_THANCRED
409.description: When you emerged some time later, and we saw that the twins were sporting magitek collars, it was clear what had taken place.

410.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_003910_THANCRED
410.description: Now, as quietly as you can, tell me everything.

411.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_003920_THANCRED
411.description: The legatus himself, eh? Now there's a surprise.

412.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_003930_THANCRED
412.description: This is also the first I've heard of a plan to join forces with the Xth and storm the Tower of Babil.

413.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_003940_THANCRED
413.description: An interesting development...and perhaps the opportunity we've been waiting for.

414.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_003950_THANCRED
414.description: Our comrades back at the camp also received some rather promising news, but it's still too early to get our hopes up.

415.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_003960_THANCRED
415.description: For now, keeping yourselves out of harm's way comes before all else. Whatever demands the Garleans make, indulge them.

416.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_003970_THANCRED
416.description: With luck, this will all be over soon. Until then.

418.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_003990_ALISAIE
418.description: We searched high and low, but no luck, I'm afraid. I might've guessed you'd be the only one to find anything.

419.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_004000_JULLUS
419.description: I wasn't expecting much to begin with. Eventually, there will be nothing left out here for us to safely salvage.

420.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_004010_JULLUS
420.description: For now, this will have to suffice. We should return to the station.

421.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_004020_COLLEAGUESOLDIER
421.description: Ah, there you are. Heard you'd gone hunting for ceruleum above ground.

423.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_004040_JULLUS
423.description: Hardly. But thanks to these three, we have enough to last a little while longer.

424.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_004050_COLLEAGUESOLDIER
424.description: Well, well. It's not at all what I was expecting, these ones. For savages, they seem positively docile.

425.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_004060_COLLEAGUESOLDIER
425.description: Ah, it's a poor attempt at humor. In all honesty, I'm grateful for your efforts. But even with another night of warmth, there are those among us who may not live to see the morrow...

426.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_004070_QUINTUS
426.description: I trust your expedition was fruitful.

428.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_004090_QUINTUS
428.description: Use what you procured to refuel the armor.

429.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_004100_JULLUS
429.description: But sir, what about the heaters for the camp?

430.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_004110_QUINTUS
430.description: The time for action is upon us.

431.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_004120_QUINTUS
431.description: My men and I have matters to discuss. In the meantime, you are to wait here. Do not forget─you are being watched.

432.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_004130_ALISAIE
432.description: “The time for action”... What did he mean by that?

433.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_004140_ALPHINAUD
433.description: I can only speculate. Clearly something requiring their magitek, given what we just heard. Whether they plan to utilize it now or after they join with the Xth is another question...

434.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_004150_ALPHINAUD
434.description: Will they ever escape this cold? Return to and reclaim the idyllic spaces of which Jullus spoke...?

436.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_004170_JULLUS
436.description: Alphinaud and Alisaie are to stay here...as our prisoners. They will be released once your comrades have relinquished their supplies and withdrawn from Garlean soil.

437.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_004180_JULLUS
437.description: Until our terms are met, they will be detained at a separate location.

438.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_004190_ALISAIE
438.description: After everything we've said and done, this is how you treat us!?

439.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_004200_ALPHINAUD
439.description: Our allies have but limited supplies. They may stave off cold and starvation for a short while, but what then!?

440.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_004210_THANCRED
440.description: For now, keeping yourselves out of harm's way comes before all else. Whatever demands the Garleans make, indulge them.

443.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_A6_000_002_NONE_VOICE
443.description: Everything will be all right. Have faith.

446.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_004240_JULLUS
446.description: Least it was until that night. I was with Lord Quintus when the capital fell, and thus spared. My family, who did not own a radio, were less fortunate.

447.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_004250_JULLUS
447.description: When dawn came, I made my way here. My parents...my little brother and sister...they were still inside...

448.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_004260_JULLUS
448.description: But they weren't themselves, and they...they tried to... And I had to...

449.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_004270_JULLUS
449.description: I'd promised to take them away from the capital that very morning. To somewhere safe, to hide until the fighting stopped.

451.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_004290_JULLUS
451.description: The Garlean flag bears a chain. The bonds between our countrymen.

452.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_004300_JULLUS
452.description: A red link at its center─the blood of the fallen. Our loved ones who lived and died for Garlemald.

453.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_004310_JULLUS
453.description: But if she, too, fell, who would be left to remember them and their sacrifice? What enduring proof would there be that they were ever here?

454.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_004320_JULLUS
454.description: If we had turned to your gods, would they have saved us?

458.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_004360_ALPHINAUD
458.description: Believe me, I do not enjoy being here any more than you. But he wanted us to play along, so that is what we will do.

459.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_004370_ALPHINAUD
459.description: Believe me, I do not enjoy being here any more than you. But she wanted us to play along, so that is what we will do.

462.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_004400_ALISAIE
462.description: I've been thinking about what Quintus said. About why no one would accept Garlean rule.

463.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_004410_ALISAIE
463.description: Irreconcilable differences. When coexistence isn't an option, only conquest remains.

464.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_004420_ALISAIE
464.description: Varis at Ghimlyt said much the same. Only by uniting the world beneath a single standard would we rid ourselves of the Ascians.

465.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_004430_ALISAIE
465.description: United...as one people. One race, cleansed of “imperfections.”

466.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_004440_ALISAIE
466.description: A cold and unforgiving vision. And when we fail to live up to their standards...what place is there for us in their world?

467.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_004450_ALISAIE
467.description: But the truly sad, truly <hex:021A020203>frustrating<hex:021A020103> thing is how damnably similar it all is to the lofty ideals of Father and the Forum.

468.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_004460_ALISAIE
468.description: Nonintervention─always nonintervention. Protect our knowledge and our people and to hells with the rest of you.

469.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_004470_ALISAIE
469.description: And yet...I can see how it happened. Varis and Father looked to their elders for guidance and took their virtues as their own. For this world was of their making─in who else could they place their trust?

470.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_004480_ALISAIE
470.description: All of us lost in a sea of chaos, searching desperately for purpose and meaning...but it shouldn't just be an extension of another's. It has to be ours. It has to be.

471.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_004490_ALISAIE
471.description: We all have a stake in this world. No one should be silenced...

472.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_004500_ALPHINAUD
472.description: I won't deny that we lack the experience of people such as Father or Quintus.

473.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_004510_ALPHINAUD
473.description: Perhaps they've come to see the world as a series of problems, and the most efficient way of solving them to reduce everything to fundamental forms.

474.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_004520_ALPHINAUD
474.description: A stone is a stone, a cloud a cloud, a flower no more than that. Simple descriptions that strip the subject of distinguishing characteristics.

475.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_004530_ALPHINAUD
475.description: A man is a man. Divided according to race, creed, or allegiance─and to some, defined by such associations.

477.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_004550_ALPHINAUD
477.description: In my misbegotten youth. But what I believed wisdom was no more than aggressive ignorance.

478.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_004560_ALPHINAUD
478.description: I've since learned to look beyond the banners and the politics. To see people as individuals with their own hopes and dreams.

479.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_004570_ALPHINAUD
479.description: As for my dream of building a better world... Well, every day I am reminded that it is far more complex than I had ever imagined.

480.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_004580_ALPHINAUD
480.description: But it only spurs me onward. To find the wisdom and the strength to see it through to the very end.

481.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_004590_LUCIA
481.description: All of our supplies and an immediate withdrawal? These are your conditions?

482.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_004600_JULLUS
482.description: Demands. And you forgot about the airship.

483.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_004610_JULLUS
483.description: Once again, you will leave one behind. It will be used to return the prisoners. Their collars will be removed prior to the exchange.

484.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_004620_ALISAIE
484.description: So in the end, not even Father's expertly worded rhetoric could deter you from your chosen course.

486.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_004640_ALISAIE
486.description: Not that I thought for a moment that it would. I've no love for violence, of course, but ours is a cause worth fighting for. I just wish he'd realize it too.

487.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_004650_ALISAIE
487.description: Sometimes the only way to protect the ones you love is to take a stand. To refuse to suffer in silence.

488.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_004660_ALISAIE
488.description: I want you to know I share your conviction. Whether it be on the battlefield or in the debating chamber, I won't back down. I guess what I'm saying is...

489.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_004670_ALPHINAUD
489.description: You've found your own reason to fight.

491.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_004690_ALISAIE
491.description: Gods willing, there will come a day when we can finally lay down our arms, and there will be peace.

492.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_004700_ALISAIE
492.description: But not until the Telophoroi have been defeated once and for all.

493.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_004710_ALISAIE
493.description: And you, Brother, will have a vital part to play. By your words and deeds, you'll lead the way.

494.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_004720_ALPHINAUD
494.description: ...I pray I am up to the task.

495.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_004730_ALISAIE
495.description: There'll always be naysayers. Those who think us fools for even trying.

496.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_004740_ALISAIE
496.description: It's easy for learned elites to criticize earnest efforts and assert their moral superiority. All without offering alternatives.

497.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_004750_ALISAIE
497.description: Not that their sophistry has ever wounded you. So stubborn and strong─stronger than you even know.

498.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_004760_ALISAIE
498.description: Don't ever change, you hear me? If you stumble, I'll be there to catch you. Or give you a thick ear. Maybe both for good measure.

500.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_004780_MAXIMA
500.description: The scouts have secured Alisaie and Alphinaud. Their collars were removed without complication as well.

501.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_004790_MAXIMA
501.description: They report no casualties─not for their party nor the guards, who will wake from their premature slumber in due course.

502.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_004800_LUCIA
502.description: It would appear the situation has changed.

503.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_004810_LUCIA
503.description: I propose new terms. We have information that will be of great interest to Lord Quintus, and I wish to speak with him in person.

504.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_004820_JULLUS
504.description: No. In the event you rejected our first proposal, we came prepared with a second.

507.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_004850_JULLUS
507.description: We, the loyal soldiers of the Ist Legion, proud servants of Garlemald...

508.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_004860_JULLUS
508.description: Of the fallen Emperor Varis, shall safeguard these lands...

509.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_004870_JULLUS
509.description: ...from the barbarian hordes until our countrymen return!

513.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_004910_ARUHNSENNA
513.description: This child may be the worst emissary I have ever seen...

514.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_004920_LUCIA
514.description: We received an urgent communication from the Grand Company of Eorzea.

515.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_004930_LUCIA
515.description: Envoys from the imperial army, led by members of the Xth Legion, came to Ala Mhigo and requested an audience.

516.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_004940_LUCIA
516.description: They explained that their efforts to coordinate the reclamation of the capital with the aid of the IVth, Vth, VIIIth, and XIIth had ended in failure.

517.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_004950_LUCIA
517.description: Communication between most legions has broken down entirely. Most of the Xth's conscripts have deserted, leaving their forces severely depleted.

518.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_004960_LUCIA
518.description: That is why, unable to continue the fight on their own, they and their allies turned to the Grand Company of Eorzea for aid.

520.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_004980_LUCIA
520.description: It is the truth, and I have not finished. The Xth has requested that we deliver a message to Lord Quintus.

522.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_005000_JULLUS
522.description: You have been listening, my lord?

525.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_005030_QUINTUS
525.description: Inform her...that we will honor the Xth's decision.

527.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_005050_QUINTUS
527.description: I release you from your duty. All of you.

528.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_005060_QUINTUS
528.description: I take solace, Your Radiance, in the knowledge you are not here to witness our debasement.

529.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_005070_QUINTUS
529.description: 'Twas a grand, glorious dream we shared.

530.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_005080_QUINTUS
530.description: Of a world united. Of peace and prosperity.

531.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_005090_QUINTUS
531.description: We are ghosts, you and I. Memories of days gone by.

532.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_005100_QUINTUS
532.description: Bonds forged in blood...that I will not see tarnished.

533.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_005110_ALISAIE
533.description: Quickly! We have to reach the station before it's too late!

534.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_005120_ALPHINAUD
534.description: If there is still a chance that Quintus will agree to a truce, we must take it.

535.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_005130_ALISAIE
535.description: I just hope we get there before he and his men do something rash...

537.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_005150_ALPHINAUD
537.description: The last of those who agreed to join us, yes.

538.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_005160_THANCRED
538.description: We left heaters and provisions for those who wished to stay behind. They won't last forever, but hopefully they'll last long enough.

539.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_005170_ALISAIE
539.description: For now, I think everyone's earned a rest.

540.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_005180_ALISAIE
540.description: We'll see to those in need of medical attention, so take the others with you and get yourselves some hot soup.

543.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_005210_EMMANELLAIN
543.description: All thanks to the resourceful machinists of Ishgard, I might add. On their behalf, I bid you warm yourself to your heart's content!

544.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_005220_SICARD
544.description: Hold on. Your people might've scribbled a few things on a piece of parchment, but it was our Lominsan smiths that put the bloody things together.

545.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_005230_EMMANELLAIN
545.description: Well, be that as it may...we single-handedly got the interior heating up and running again, didn't we?

546.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_005240_SICARD
546.description: The hells you did! We were there every step of the way!

547.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_005250_EMMANELLAIN
547.description: “We”!? You barely raised a finger to help, you ale-sodden reprobate!

548.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_005260_SICARD
548.description: I did a damn sight more than you, you lily-livered bilge rat!

551.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_005290_EMMANELLAIN
551.description: I will not stoop to your level!

553.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_005310_ALAMHIGANDELEGATION
553.description: At ease, man. There's nothing funny in it.

554.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_005320_ALAMHIGANDELEGATION
554.description: I'm from Ala Mhigo, but was a conscript until recently. Used to eat this with the officers.

555.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_005330_ULDAHNDELEGATION
555.description: Apparently, it's adapted from a Steppe recipe. This is my first time trying it, and I have to say it's not half bad.

556.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_005340_GRIDANIANDELEGATION
556.description: Hmm... It's a bit too flavorful for my liking...

557.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_005350_ULDAHNDELEGATION
557.description: Perhaps compared to what you're used to.

558.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_005360_ALAMHIGANDELEGATION
558.description: It's the little things that make life worth living, don't you think?

560.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_005380_LUCIA
560.description: I know this is not a dream, and yet...

561.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_005390_LUCIA
561.description: I felt the same way at the Dragonsong War's end. Every morning I would step outside and need to be reminded that it wasn't my imagination. That my world had been forever changed.

562.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_005400_LUCIA
562.description: And just as I had grown accustomed to the idea, again you change my world in ways I never thought possible.

563.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_005410_LUCIA
563.description: Were it not for you and your fellow Scions, the rifts between man and dragon and myriad tribes might never have been bridged.

564.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_005420_LUCIA
564.description: The Grand Company of Eorzea, the Ilsabard contingent... We owe it all to you.

565.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_005430_LUCIA
565.description: We've shed many tears in recent days. Of pain and sorrow. Triumph and joy. I much prefer the latter.

568.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_A7_000_002_NONE_VOICE
568.description: We often don't have the luxury of choice.

569.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_005440_LUCIA
569.description: I am honored to fight by your side. As an Eorzean and Garlean both, I shall do all in my power to bring my peoples together.

570.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_005450_LUCIA
570.description: Indeed. We can but do our utmost to unite these disparate peoples and lead them to victory.

571.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_005460_MAXIMA
571.description: It is a remarkable achievement─everything that I and the Populares had hoped for and more.

572.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_005470_LUCIA
572.description: Would that it had come sooner.

573.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_005480_MAXIMA
573.description: Indeed. Too many are not here to see it. And yet...there is a warmth in my breast. As if they still share in this moment.

574.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_005490_LUCIA
574.description: Yes. I know what you mean.

575.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_005500_LUCIA
575.description: On a night like tonight, the wind and cold seem to pass me by.

579.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_005540_URIANGER
