579.description: They are being tempered! The talismans─quickly!

582.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_005570_AMON
582.description: Ahem! My lord has requested your presence, and I would hate to disappoint him...

583.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_005580_AMON
583.description: The experiment was a success, but I fear our time is short.

585.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_005600_AMON
585.description: Now...it is time for you to awaken.

586.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_005610_AMON
586.description: Good morrow to you. Here─have a taste before it gets cold.

587.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_005620_AMON
587.description: Oh, but be sure to remove your helmet. Take a moment, too, to familiarize yourself with that borrowed flesh.

588.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_005630_AMON
588.description: So? How does it feel? I, for one, find those first moments within a new body to be most refreshing!

589.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_005640_AMON
589.description: We had a magitek engineer by the name of Aulus to thank for this method of soul extraction and implantation. I believe the two of you met briefly in Ala Mhigo?

590.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_005650_AMON
590.description: His was a rather sticky end, wasn't it? Thankfully, he was thoughtful enough to leave behind his mindjack technology. I took the liberty of making some improvements─and selecting you as my esteemed test subject.

593.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_A8_000_002_NONE_VOICE
593.description: This is <hex:021A020203>such<hex:021A020103> a pain in the arse.

594.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_005660_AMON
594.description: And permit you to go on a righteous rampage instead of partaking in this delicious meal? I think not.

595.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_005670_AMON
595.description: Come now, to us Ascians, it is no different from trying on new clothes. Why not make the most of it by partaking in this fine cuisine?

596.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_005680_AMON
596.description: I must say, I have gone to great lengths to reunite you with my lord.

597.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_005690_AMON
597.description: When I discovered that his “friend” was in this neck of the woods, I suggested inviting you over for dinner.

598.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_005700_AMON
598.description: He never deigned to respond, but I took his silence as a resounding yes!

599.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_005710_AMON
599.description: Oh my! Daddy is pleased his grumpy little boy has finally found his playmate!

601.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_005730_AMON
601.description: The Garlean Empire has long outlawed all forms of religion. No gods to worship, no risk of summoning. Brilliantly simple.

602.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_005740_AMON
602.description: But people, being people, must turn to something or someone in their hour of need. Who, then?

603.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_005750_AMON
603.description: Why, His Radiance the Emperor, of course.

604.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_005760_AMON
604.description: As you have observed firsthand, Garlemald has seen better days. The legendary Solus zos Galvus─dead. Provinces near and far─in open rebellion. Our bold new Emperor─assassinated! And that last one even sparked a civil war! What rotten luck.

605.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_005770_AMON
605.description: The people cried out for salvation, their earnest pleas─one might even call them prayers─a supplication united for the Empire to reclaim her former glory.

606.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_005780_AMON
606.description: And so their will did manifest, channeled through the corpse of none other than Emperor Varis himself!

607.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_005790_AMON
607.description: And lo, the savior was born! The embodiment of the Garlean spirit, their Anima!

608.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_005800_AMON
608.description: It calls to its subjects, compelling them to take up arms and fight.

609.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_005810_AMON
609.description: And just as the wealth and power gravitate towards the Empire's capital, so too does aether, from every corner of the globe!

610.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_005820_AMON
610.description: The towers with which you and your allies have been so preoccupied were created as an extension of Anima itself. An ingenious design...

611.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_005830_AMON
611.description: Would you not agree, my lord?

612.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_005840_ZENOS
612.description: Does the pursuit of prey you have bested before excite you?

613.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_005850_ZENOS
613.description: Of course not. Absent the challenge, the thrill, your prize is a hollow victory. Butchery.

614.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_005860_ZENOS
614.description: Perhaps you think that to be the extent of my promise. I have no doubt fallen in your estimation since Ala Mhigo.

615.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_005870_ZENOS
615.description: Fair enough. But do not let your disdain deprive you─deprive us─of an opportunity to craft an even more majestic moment of euphoria.

616.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_005880_ZENOS
616.description: I have been honing my craft as I set the stage for our reunion.

617.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_005890_ZENOS
617.description: Wheresoever there is suffering and despair, you appear, to fulfill your duty as defender of this star.

618.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_005900_ZENOS
618.description: The chaos and destruction that my hordes have wrought...are my gifts to you alone.

619.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_005910_ZENOS
619.description: At a loss for words? No matter. As you will learn, I have only just begun.

620.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_005920_AMON
620.description: Oh? Will you not finish your meal?

621.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_005930_ZENOS
621.description: There is only one thing that can sate my hunger, and it would seem my friend has lost <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468697303> appetite.

622.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_005940_ZENOS
622.description: I hoped this display of civility might prove an entertaining diversion, but clearly we are above such pretensions.

623.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_005950_ZENOS
623.description: While my lifeless body was in the possession of the Ascian, I too claimed another's as my own.

624.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_005960_ZENOS
624.description: It was an enlightening experience, to fight in an unfamiliar form. Flaws and failings in my technique were plain to see.

625.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_005970_ZENOS
625.description: Whence rises one's true strength? The flesh? The soul? Perhaps you should like to discover the answer for yourself.

627.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_005990_AMON
627.description: Oh dear! Whatever would happen if my lord were to greet your friends as you? I shudder to imagine what carnage he would wreak!

628.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_006000_AMON
628.description: We'd better hurry if we want to avert the bloodbath. You can thank me later for my generosity.

629.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_006010_AMON
629.description: Ah, there it is. Your camp, I believe.

630.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_006020_AMON
630.description: If I were to hazard a guess, I would say that you─the other you─is making <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468697303> way there as we speak.

631.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_006030_AMON
631.description: Alas, this you will have to walk from here. Or run, if you can manage it. My lord would be cross if I made it too easy.

632.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_006040_AMON
632.description: Such ingratitude. I'd not squander this fighting chance. After all, you've obstacles enough to overcome─right on cue!

633.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_006050_AMON
633.description: Tempered soldiers, with standing orders to kill those not sworn to Anima.

634.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_006060_AMON
634.description: Under normal circumstances you would make short work of them. But on this occasion, the odds are not so heavily stacked in your favor.

635.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_006070_YSHTOLA
635.description: It is a miracle we were able to restrain the tempered without suffering casualties.

636.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_006080_LUCIA
636.description: A welcome one. A-Ruhn-Senna and the others have their hands full as it is. Thankfully, there are enough scales for everyone.

637.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_006090_ALPHINAUD
637.description: And what of Jullus? His symptoms were particularly severe.

638.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_006100_LUCIA
638.description: They were, but others fared still worse, including some brought back from the Magna Glacies.

639.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_006110_LUCIA
639.description: As those in most desperate need take priority, it may be a while before he receives treatment.

640.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_006120_LUCIA
640.description: But rest assured that he will. In the meantime, we must find our missing friend. May the Fury guide you.

641.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_006130_ESTINIEN
641.description: Of all the bloody times for a disappearing act...

642.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_006140_THANCRED
642.description: Right when the first wave struck. We'd be fools to think it a coincidence.

643.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_006150_THANCRED
643.description: But where even to begin the search? No one saw <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468696D03> leave in the chaos, and we've no trail to follow.

644.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_006160_ALPHINAUD
644.description: While I know full well <hex:02080CE905FF04736865FF03686503> can handle <hex:020815E905FF0868657273656C66FF0868696D73656C6603>, I worry all the same.

646.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_006180_ALISAIE
646.description: Well! Time to call off the search!

649.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_006210_URIANGER
649.description: Aye, 'twould appear so. Thou art struggling to perceive <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468697303> presence?

650.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_006220_YSHTOLA
650.description: I am. Perhaps, in the aftermath of the wave, there is some residual effect interfering with my faculties, but...

651.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_006230_ALISAIE
651.description: Where have you been? We've been worried sick!

652.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_006240_GRAHATIA
652.description: Now, now, all's well that ends well. Are you all right?

657.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_A9_000_002_NONE_VOICE
657.description: Get away from them, you bastard!

658.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_006270_AMON
658.description: Sadly, that is all we have time for today. The effect has run its course, and back to your own bodies you must go.

659.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_006280_AMON
659.description: But where are my manners? You have all traveled so very far, and I have yet to pay my respects.

660.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_006290_AMON
660.description: Though in my defense, I was ill prepared to receive so many uninvited guests. As such, preliminary entertainments were in order.

661.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_006300_AMON
661.description: A handful of tempered soldiers to hamper your progress. Refugees to command your attention while I siphoned their ceruleum from the shadows─particularly effective, that.

662.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_006310_AMON
662.description: Charitable souls that you are, you bent over backwards to aid them, heedless of the delay. Predictable to a fault! And so my plan approaches completion unhindered.

663.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_006320_AMON
663.description: Anima will soon have absorbed the requisite amount of aether, and then shall come the spectacle to end all spectacles!

664.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_006330_AMON
664.description: The eldest and most powerful of primals will awaken, and all shall bear witness to the Final Days!

665.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_006340_ZENOS
665.description: The gods themselves will be my meal. Your dear companions my dessert. Upon this world I'll feast, and death shall follow in my wake.

666.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_006350_ZENOS
666.description: All your hate, all your rage, you will render unto me.

667.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_006360_VRITRA
667.description: For upon thy life's reel wind too many threads. Of fate. Power. Weal, enmeshed with woe.

668.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_006370_VRITRA
668.description: More terrible still is the attrition wrought upon thy companions, as they are swept up in the storm of thine existence.

669.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_006380_VRITRA
669.description: Take heart and protect them well. They will be your strength and your salvation.

674.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_006400_GRAHATIA
674.description: Perfectly fine, yes. I hope the same can be said of you.

675.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_006410_GRAHATIA
675.description: I am pleased to report you are very much alive.

677.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_006430_ALISAIE
677.description: That's a relief. Oh, and before I forget: thanks for coming to our rescue.

678.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_006440_YSHTOLA
678.description: Given recent events, I would be surprised if you weren't feeling a bit poorly.

679.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_006450_YSHTOLA
679.description: A hearty meal and a long rest would be my recommendation under normal circumstances, but these are anything but. If Fandaniel's boasts are to be believed, we must act quickly.

680.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_006460_YSHTOLA
680.description: Once you've blown away the cobwebs, we can discuss preparations for our assault on the Tower of Babil.

682.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_006480_ALPHINAUD
682.description: Farewell, Varis. May the gods have mercy on your soul.

685.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_006510_AMON
685.description: Oh hush. This is the best part...

689.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_006550_AMON
689.description: O mighty Zodiark, awaken from your slumber and descend!

692.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_006580_HYDAELYN
692.description: (-Hydaelyn-)The shackles that bind my adversary will not be so easily broken!

693.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_006590_AMON
693.description: Hydaelyn... Feeble relic of a forgotten age...

695.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_006610_AMON
695.description: No more aether... And I was so close!

696.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_006620_AMON
696.description: My lord, a slight change of plans. We shall travel to the moon and break this wretched barrier ourselves!

699.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_006650_ZENOS
699.description: The final order issued by Anima to the tempered thralls.

700.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_006660_ZENOS
700.description: “Should the Empire fall, the world must share her fate.”

701.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_006670_ZENOS
701.description: Of course, Father lacked the conviction to give such a command. The abomination born of his flesh was but a puppet─and I the puppeteer.

703.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_006690_AMON
703.description: There's a funny joy in watching your flailing attempts to fight the inevitable. You're all going to die and are powerless to prevent it.

704.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_006700_AMON
704.description: We really must be on our way. You're welcome to give chase, provided you are content to leave comrade and tempered alike to die screaming.

705.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_006710_HYDAELYN
705.description: (-Hydaelyn-)I have asked too much of this child. Tend to her.

706.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_006720_HYDAELYN
706.description: (-Hydaelyn-)The last brand at Mare Lamentorum is yet unbroken. Zodiark remains bound.

707.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_006730_HYDAELYN
707.description: (-Hydaelyn-)I have shifted the flow of aether and sent the enemy far from their destination.

708.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_006740_HYDAELYN
708.description: (-Hydaelyn-)Now, I shall divert it once more. An ally awaits, and I will deliver you unto him.

709.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_006750_HYDAELYN
709.description: (-Hydaelyn-)Seek his aid. Restore the seal. Zodiark must not be set free...

710.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_006760_THANCRED
710.description: The tempered are running wild. Not only those at the tower, but those back at the camp.

711.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_006770_THANCRED
711.description: The others are doing their best to contain them, but the situation is growing beyond our control.

712.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_006780_ALISAIE
712.description: Leave them to die, or give up the chase. Just like Fandaniel said...

715.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_A11_000_002_NONE_VOICE
715.description: Only I can bring an end to this.

716.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_A11_000_003_NONE_VOICE
716.description: Garlemald's fate is in your hands.

718.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_006800_ALPHINAUD
718.description: You have our trust and our faith. I pray we have yours.

719.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_006810_ALPHINAUD
719.description: Our friends and the tempered need our help. We will save as many as we can─I swear!

720.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_006820_THANCRED
720.description: Once we have matters well in hand, we will join you on the moon. Until then, be careful. There's no telling what you'll find.

721.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_006830_EMETSELCH
721.description: Long, long before Dalamud was forged to imprison an elder primal...

722.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_006840_EMETSELCH
722.description: The eldest of them all─savior of the star─was sealed within a moon of His own.

723.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_006850_EMETSELCH
723.description: Souls sacrificed to grant Him life still slumber and dream of the day He and we will be made whole.

724.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_006860_EMETSELCH
724.description: Here He waits, in this cold, barren place. His cradle and His grave.

725.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_006870_EMETSELCH
725.description: Silent lamentations and prayers of hope echo soundlessly to a sundered star, adrift and alone.

728.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_006900_WATCHEROFMOON
728.description: <hex:024804F2022303>Apologies. I have been preoccupied for quite some time, and am...out of practice at conversation...<hex:0248020103>

729.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_006910_WATCHEROFMOON
729.description: <hex:024804F2022303>Ever since this moon was created by Hydaelyn, I have served as...an integral part. I am the watcher.<hex:0248020103>

730.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_006920_WATCHEROFMOON
730.description: <hex:024804F2022303>I am responsible for the prisoner and the devices that hold Him fast.<hex:0248020103>

731.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_006930_WATCHEROFMOON
731.description: <hex:024804F2022303>Zodiark Himself. A projection of the moon's core.<hex:0248020103>

732.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_006940_WATCHEROFMOON
732.description: <hex:024804F2022303>Though rent asunder by Hydaelyn, He grows more powerful with every Rejoining. Seven there have been. Seven too many...<hex:0248020103>

733.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_006950_WATCHEROFMOON
733.description: <hex:024804F2022303>And yet, for all His servants' machinations, He remains incomplete. The fallen are beyond salvation.<hex:0248020103>

734.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_006960_WATCHEROFMOON
734.description: <hex:024804F2022303>No attempt would be made to free Zodiark. Not until He is whole once more.<hex:0248020103>

735.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_006970_WATCHEROFMOON
735.description: <hex:024804F2022303>But someone has taken action. The shackles that hold Him nearly shattered.<hex:0248020103>

736.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_006980_WATCHEROFMOON
736.description: <hex:024804F2022303>Six locks to his gaol, great and grand.<hex:0248020103>

737.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_006990_WATCHEROFMOON
737.description: <hex:024804F2022303>Gargantuan swords driven deep. Brands to bind Zodiark forevermore.<hex:0248020103>

738.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_007000_WATCHEROFMOON
738.description: <hex:024804F2022303>Five were destroyed by his would-be liberator. One of these I have restored.<hex:0248020103>

739.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_007010_WATCHEROFMOON
739.description: <hex:024804F2022303>I strive to mend the remaining four, but my efforts are being impeded...<hex:0248020103>

740.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_007020_WATCHEROFMOON
740.description: <hex:024804F2022303>Souls sacrificed to summon Zodiark, their manifestation consequence of the waning seal.<hex:0248020103>

741.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_007030_WATCHEROFMOON
741.description: <hex:024804F2022303>They labor in opposition to my work. They must be expelled for the preservation of all.<hex:0248020103>

743.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_A12_000_001_NONE_VOICE
743.description: If keeping Zodiark imprisoned is the right thing to do, I will aid you.

744.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_A12_000_002_NONE_VOICE
744.description: I will only resort to “expelling” them if all else fails.

745.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_007040_WATCHEROFMOON
745.description: <hex:024804F2022303>What is right and good? Ask a thousand souls and receive a thousand answers. I offer none.<hex:0248020103>

746.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_007050_WATCHEROFMOON
746.description: <hex:024804F2022303>Of that I have no doubt. You are Her chosen.<hex:0248020103>

747.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_007060_WATCHEROFMOON
747.description: <hex:024804F2022303>I am the watcher and the gaoler. I am not the judge.<hex:0248020103>

748.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_007070_WATCHEROFMOON
748.description: <hex:024804F2022303>Know this. Hydaelyn commands the forces of stasis, and this moon is the product of such power.<hex:0248020103>

749.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_007080_WATCHEROFMOON
749.description: <hex:024804F2022303>So long as Zodiark remains imprisoned in this place, no more sacrifices will be made in His name. Nor will those souls rendered up in His name fade into oblivion.<hex:0248020103>

750.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_007090_WATCHEROFMOON
750.description: <hex:024804F2022303>Go. Meet with these wandering spirits. Do what you think is right.<hex:0248020103>

751.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_007100_ANCIENTSHADOWA
751.description: <hex:024804F2022303>Our perfection came crumbling down. Such overwhelming despair. In that moment, we knew. The end was nigh.<hex:0248020103>

752.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_007110_ANCIENTSHADOWA
752.description: <hex:024804F2022303>The faintest glimmer of hope remained. We gave our lives that others may live. We gave ourselves...to Zodiark.<hex:0248020103>

757.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_007160_ANCIENTSHADOWA
757.description: <hex:024804F2022303>Fill earth and heaven with life. Birth paradise where fear is distant memory.<hex:0248020103>

758.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_007170_HYTHLODAEUS
758.description: (-???-)<hex:024804F2022303>Pardon me, but would you be so kind as to step aside?<hex:0248020103>

759.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_007180_HYTHLODAEUS
759.description: (-Familiar Spirit-)<hex:024804F2022303>Ah. That unmistakable color. The soul of Azem.<hex:0248020103>

760.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_007190_HYTHLODAEUS
760.description: (-Familiar Spirit-)<hex:024804F2022303>But not the friend I knew, I think. Nevertheless, you are you.<hex:0248020103>

761.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_007200_HYTHLODAEUS
761.description: (-Familiar Spirit-)<hex:024804F2022303>Hmm... So, Emet-Selch meant for you to have it.<hex:0248020103>

762.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_007210_HYTHLODAEUS
762.description: (-Familiar Spirit-)<hex:024804F2022303>You seem surprised. Why might that be?<hex:0248020103>

765.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_A13_000_002_NONE_VOICE
765.description: You're the receptionist at the Bureau of the Secretariat, correct?

766.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_007220_HYTHLODAEUS
766.description: <hex:024804F2022303>Again? I do not believe I have yet had the pleasure.<hex:0248020103>

767.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_007230_HYTHLODAEUS
767.description: <hex:024804F2022303>Chief of the Bureau of the Architect, in fact. My name is “Hythlodaeus.”<hex:0248020103>

768.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_007240_HYTHLODAEUS
768.description: <hex:024804F2022303>But how did you come to be familiar with our bureaus?<hex:0248020103>

769.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_007250_HYTHLODAEUS
769.description: <hex:024804F2022303>Emet-Selch created a shade in my likeness? And not only me, but all of Amaurot?<hex:0248020103>

770.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_007260_HYTHLODAEUS
770.description: <hex:024804F2022303>Heh heh... How very like him... Heh heh heh...<hex:0248020103>

771.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_007270_HYTHLODAEUS
771.description: <hex:024804F2022303>A slave to sentiment, even after an eternity.<hex:0248020103>

772.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_007280_HYTHLODAEUS
772.description: <hex:024804F2022303>As you may have guessed, I am different from the shade you met before. No mere approximation, but the original.<hex:0248020103>

774.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_007300_HYTHLODAEUS
774.description: <hex:024804F2022303>We remember in vivid detail the events leading to our purgatory.<hex:0248020103>

775.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_007310_HYTHLODAEUS
775.description: <hex:024804F2022303>The plans and plots for our resurrection. Hydaelyn's intervention, and Zodiark's─and the star's─final fate.<hex:0248020103>

776.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_007320_HYTHLODAEUS
776.description: <hex:024804F2022303>And then we drifted in a waking dream, our minds steeped in fog...until you came.<hex:0248020103>

777.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_007330_HYTHLODAEUS
777.description: <hex:024804F2022303>I know not what you and your friends intend for Zodiark or the future of the star. Nevertheless...<hex:0248020103>

778.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_007340_HYTHLODAEUS
778.description: <hex:024804F2022303>In you I place my trust and faith. In you I choose to believe, as Emet-Selch did.<hex:0248020103>

779.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_007350_HYTHLODAEUS
779.description: <hex:024804F2022303>Believe in yourself, and all will be well.<hex:0248020103>

780.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_007360_HYTHLODAEUS
780.description: <hex:024804F2022303>Hmm, more new arrivals. Though... Ah. Fandaniel. That color I know.<hex:0248020103>

781.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_007370_HYTHLODAEUS
781.description: <hex:024804F2022303>And another I do not. An unfamiliar but fearsome being...<hex:0248020103>

782.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_007380_HYTHLODAEUS
782.description: <hex:024804F2022303>I have kept you from your duty. By way of apology, I will ensure that the shades hinder you no more.<hex:0248020103>

784.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_007400_HYTHLODAEUS
784.description: <hex:024804F2022303>Fare you well, my new old friend.<hex:0248020103>

786.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_007420_AMON
786.description: In the nick of time to savor the crowning triumph.

787.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_007430_AMON
787.description: Unbound and free at last. Arise, Zodiark!

788.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_007440_AMON
788.description: Deprived of heart and will by the loss of dearest Elidibus...

789.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_007450_AMON
789.description: A creature of pure instinct, wanting for guidance...

790.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_007460_AMON
790.description: But powerful, oh so powerful. More so with every passing moment.

791.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_007470_AMON
791.description: Such potential, even in this incomplete state. Still the savior who delivered a world from certain doom.

793.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_007490_ZENOS
793.description: You know my intent. Consume the god, then the world. Stoke your fury to a raging inferno and dance among the ashes.

794.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_007500_ZENOS
794.description: Or perhaps you would face me here and now? A lesser but welcome amusement.

795.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_007510_ZENOS
795.description: Yes... A taste to whet the appetite.

796.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_007520_AMON
796.description: Sorry to spoil the moment, but might I ask that you postpone the slaughter until I have said my piece? I promise I will be brief.

797.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_007530_AMON
797.description: Do you remember when I told you that I wanted to die and take everyone with me? I meant it.

799.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_007550_ANCIENTSHADOWB
799.description: We are the guardian. The keeper of natural order.

800.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_007560_ANCIENTSHADOWC
800.description: We are the martyr. The bestower of new beginnings.

803.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_007590_AMON
803.description: (-Fandaniel-)Such lofty aspirations! And what sweet irony that the world's saviors will become the agents of its destruction!

805.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_007610_ANCIENTSHADOWA
805.description: We must return and be made whole!

806.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_007620_ANCIENTSHADOWB
806.description: We are the will of the star, now and forever!

807.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_007630_ANCIENTSHADOWD
807.description: For the greater good! For the sake of the world!

808.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_007640_AMON
808.description: (-Fandaniel-)Wrong! Wrong! Wrong! Wrong! Wrong! Lies and delusion!

809.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_007650_AMON
809.description: (-Fandaniel-)The dead have no power over me. You will be silent─silent as the grave!

811.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_007670_ANCIENTSHADOWC
811.description: No more, we beg of you...

813.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_007690_HYTHLODAEUS
813.description: (-Familiar Stranger-)Believe, and walk in faith. Let the light of your soul shine for all to see.

814.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_007700_HYTHLODAEUS
814.description: (-Familiar Stranger-)Not quite the outcome you'd imagined, but a fitting one nonetheless.

816.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_007720_ZODIARK
816.description: All I craved and more... Boundless power, mine to command...

818.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_007740_ZODIARK
818.description: I had intended to pit my fractured divinity against Zenos...but a more tempting option presents itself.

819.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_007750_ZODIARK
819.description: The greatest obstacle to my ambition. You will trouble me no longer.

820.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_007760_ZODIARK
820.description: Establishing connection. All creation shall bend to my will...

821.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_007770_ZODIARK
821.description: Is this the limit of your power!? Is this how it ends!?

822.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_007780_WATCHEROFMOON
822.description: (-The Watcher-)<hex:024804F2022303>Well done. My preparations are complete, and I stand ready to seal Zodiark once more.<hex:0248020103>

823.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_007790_WATCHEROFMOON
823.description: (-The Watcher-)<hex:024804F2022303>Withdraw now from this place. The teleporter will deliver you to safety.<hex:0248020103>

824.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_007800_ZODIARK
824.description: Haha...heh heh heh... Incomplete...and insufficient. Of course He was no match.

825.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_007810_ZODIARK
825.description: Once again, you have left my best-laid plans in ruins...

826.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_007820_ZODIARK
826.description: And played your role to perfection, thus sealing my victory!

827.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_007830_ZODIARK
827.description: From the first, all I wanted was for you to kill Zodiark.

828.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_007840_ZODIARK
828.description: 'Twas but one of many methods to achieve the desired effect. 'Twould've been the same had Zenos died in my place.

829.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_007850_ZODIARK
829.description: But what better and more satisfying way to ensure success than to take control myself?

830.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_007860_ZODIARK
830.description: My sole regret is that you live to tell the tale. Even so, I have fulfilled my heart's desire!

831.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_007870_ZODIARK
831.description: Let your murder mark the beginning of the end...

832.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_007880_ZODIARK
832.description: The coming of the Final Days!

833.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_007890_ZODIARK
833.description: (-Fandaniel-)How quickly strength fades, and blood cools. Old, familiar sensations...

834.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_007900_ZODIARK
834.description: (-Fandaniel-)So many lives. So many deaths. No different, this. I close my eyes and slip into the dreamless slumber.

835.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_007910_ZODIARK
835.description: (-Fandaniel-)A tired song and dance. Routine. Always I wake.

836.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_007920_ZODIARK
836.description: (-Fandaniel-)But not this time─hah! Nothing left unsaid, nothing left undone. Inherit my hell, I intone with glee.

837.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_007930_ZODIARK
837.description: (-Fandaniel-)The man I was would weep for what I have become. The all-consuming contempt.

838.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_007940_ZODIARK
838.description: (-Fandaniel-)But I've the wisdom of ten millennia to justify my answer to the question. No value in their existence─not a whit. For all that I looked, none that I did see.

839.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_007950_ZODIARK
839.description: (-Fandaniel-)A final chance, then, for Hydaelyn and Her faithful. In cataclysm prove me wrong, I sneer.

840.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_007960_ZODIARK
840.description: (-Fandaniel-)All shall return to nothingness. As was your will, Emperor Xande.

841.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_007970_ZODIARK
841.description: (-Fandaniel-)I, the star, and every living being...consigned to your oblivion.

844.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_008000_WATCHEROFMOON
844.description: <hex:024804F2022303>You saw it too, yes? The blue star below, thrown into turmoil.<hex:0248020103>

845.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_008010_WATCHEROFMOON
845.description: <hex:024804F2022303>Then it was no illusion. All was truth.<hex:0248020103>

846.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_008020_WATCHEROFMOON
846.description: <hex:024804F2022303>With the death of Zodiark, the laws of nature over which He presided have begun to unravel. The Final Days are upon us.<hex:0248020103>

847.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_008030_WATCHEROFMOON
847.description: <hex:024804F2022303>What you witnessed was an omen granted by the Echo. A vision of the horrors to come.<hex:0248020103>

849.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_008050_ZENOS
849.description: (-Zenos-)No. I'll find no fulfillment in a contest with you this day.

850.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_008060_ZENOS
850.description: Slavering beasts gather at your gates, ravenous and eager. Already you turn to them and away from me.

851.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_008070_ZENOS
851.description: I must go forth once more in search of power far beyond the might of Shinryu─power to make your heart run over with rage.

852.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_008080_ZENOS
852.description: For the eldest of primals was a betrayal of promise. A pathetic creature incapable of inspiring true despair. Aye, that's what I crave─pure, unadulterated despair...

855.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06001_A14_000_002_NONE_VOICE
855.description: I will not fight for your amusement.
